تحترفين (form VIII)
# تَحْتَرِفِينَ (taḥtarifīna) /taħ.ta.ri.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
# تُحْتَرَفِينَ (tuḥtarafīna) /tuħ.ta.ra.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
